en: I fell at the edge of dusk
into a quiet valley with no name

id: Kau angkat cahaya yang hampir padam
en: You lifted a light that had almost died
sung: Kau angkat cahaya yang hampir padam

en: and carried it home in your hands
You blow your bugle from the tower
and wake the morning for the town
But every day my light grows faint

id: Bintang tak bisa lama tinggal di sini
en: A star cannot stay here long
sung: Bintang tak bisa lama tinggal di sini

en: Don't cry, my brave one
Take me up to the highest peak

id: Bawa aku pulang ke langit senja
en: Take me home to the twilight sky
sung: Bawa aku pulang ke langit senja

id: Walau esok kita tak lagi bersama
zh: 哪怕明天我们不再相守
en: even if tomorrow we are no longer together
sung: Walau esok kita tak lagi bersama

zh: 当暮色降临，吹响你的号角
en: Blow your bugle when the evening comes

zh: 我就是那颗回应你名字的星
en: I am the star that answers to your name
The storm comes down on the mountain road
Shadow wolves close in around us
You stand tall in front of me

id: Dengan lagu yang tak pernah ragu
en: with a song that never wavers
sung: Dengan lagu yang tak pernah ragu

id: Air matamu jatuh jadi hujan cahaya
zh: 你的泪落下，化作光之雨
en: Your tears fall and turn to rain of light
sung: Air matamu jatuh jadi hujan cahaya

en: Don't forget me
I will never be far
